start_here: Say to your AI: "Cancel TidyCal booking <id>." It runs tool:cancel-a-tidycal-booking.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it cancels one booking on your TidyCal account.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI what to book or cancel, with the TidyCal booking type id or booking id.
2. The AI calls tools:run with the tool and its input.
3. Read the answer; the booking is real, so check its time and status.

worked_examples.title: Cancel booking 12345
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/tidycal/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json: a PATCH to https://tidycal.com/api/bookings/{booking_id}/cancel with the vault key tidycal-api-token. The cancel cannot be undone.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers the cancelled booking 12345 with cancelled_at set to the time it was cancelled.
